intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in {{cityA}}, but they are not in the same league on official recognition. This page compares official Nirma fees, recorded placements and NIRF 2025 Law ranks, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Nirma University vs Rai University for integrated law is a CLAT-route law school compared with a private university that has no exam listed here. Nirma is ranked 33 in NIRF 2025 Law.

sections.heading: Nirma University vs Rai University for Integrated Law: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Nirma University if you want a 2025 NIRF Law rank of 33, a CLAT route, and official 2026-27 yearly tuition of ₹3.75 lakh, as published on Nirma's B.A., LL.B. (Hons.) admissions page.
Choose Rai University only if a much lower recorded year tuition is decisive and you have checked its official law notice. Rai has no NIRF Law rank and no placement row on this page.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: Nirma University's official B.A., LL.B. (Hons.) page lists yearly tuition of ₹3,75,000 for the five-year integrated programme. The same table lists a first-year amount payable of ₹4,25,700, including a refundable deposit, exam charges and one-time items such as internship and placement facilitation.
Our records now follow that official yearly tuition of ₹3.75 lakh. Confirm the current circular before you budget, because NRI fees are listed separately in US dollars.

Rai University has recorded law tuition of ₹70,000 a year, plus an application fee of ₹600. The application fee is not the programme tuition. The recorded year fee is far lower than Nirma's official tuition, so check what programme and recognition the Rai circular actually covers.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Nirma's recorded 2023 figures on this page are an average package of ₹5 lakh and a highest package of ₹10 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

Nirma's official admissions page also lists an average salary of ₹6.70 lakh and a highest salary of ₹20 lakh, without a clearly labelled year in the table we opened. Use the official placement report, and do not mix those figures with the 2023 row as if they were one batch.
Rai University has no placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official law placement report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Nirma lists CLAT on this page. Its official admissions note says admission to the five-year integrated programmes is based on the All India CLAT merit rank, plus the Institute of Law application form.
Rai University has no exam listed in our records here. Confirm Rai's current official law admissions page for tests, eligibility and Bar Council recognition.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses. Nirma's Institute of Law is on the university campus on the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway, about 15–17 km from the city, as the official page states.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, the choice is about CLAT, the NIRF Law rank and the official fee, not a change of city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a 2025 NIRF Law rank, a CLAT route and a published official fee, Nirma University is the stronger fit on this page.

Rai University's recorded year tuition is much lower, but this page has no NIRF Law rank and no placement record for it. Confirm recognition and the official notice before you treat ₹70,000 as a substitute for Nirma.
For Nirma, budget from the official yearly tuition of ₹3.75 lakh and the first-year payable figure of ₹4.25 lakh, not from an invented five-year total.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Nirma University or Rai University, for integrated law?
faqs.answer: Nirma University has a 2025 NIRF Law rank of 33, a CLAT route and official 2026-27 yearly tuition of ₹3.75 lakh. Rai University has recorded tuition of ₹70,000 a year, but no NIRF Law rank and no placement record on this page.

faqs.question: What are the official integrated-law fees for Nirma vs Rai?
faqs.answer: Nirma's official page lists yearly tuition of ₹3,75,000 and a first-year amount payable of ₹4,25,700. Rai University's recorded tuition is ₹70,000 a year; a ₹600 application fee is not the programme tuition. Confirm both official notices.

faqs.question: Does Nirma University accept CLAT?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nirma lists CLAT on this page, and its official admissions note says the five-year integrated programmes use the All India CLAT merit rank.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Nirma's recorded 2023 figures are a ₹5 lakh average and a ₹10 lakh highest package. Its official admissions page also lists ₹6.70 lakh average and ₹20 lakh highest, without a clearly labelled year. Rai has no placement record on this page.

faqs.question: Are Nirma University and Rai University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Nirma's Institute of Law is on the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway campus.

faqs.question: Should I multiply Nirma's yearly tuition by five to get a programme total?
faqs.answer: No. The official page gives a yearly tuition and a first-year payable figure. It does not publish a single five-year lump sum in the table we opened. Use the current official circular.
